query:
-- Incoming delegates: Yuliia Zembal (UKRSIBBANK), Sonal Jain (Nissan), Nikhilesh Mathur (LSEG), 
-- Cath Possamai (Amazon) -- JPMorgan and Macquarie not found in attendees yet
-- Check their existing meeting slots across ALL sponsors
SELECT 
  m.attendeeId,
  m.timeSlot,
  m.attendeeNumber,
  s.companyName as bookedWith
FROM meetings m
JOIN sponsors s ON s.id = m.sponsorId
WHERE m.isVisible = 1
  AND m.attendeeId IN (
    '128491656706', -- Yuliia Zembal, UKRSIBBANK
    '110260566550', -- Sonal Jain, Nissan
    '191181016455', -- Nikhilesh Mathur, LSEG
    '452351'        -- Cath Possamai, Amazon
  )
ORDER BY m.attendeeId, m.timeSlot;
